entities.name: National Hockey Stadium, Lahore
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: National Hockey Stadium is a purpose-built field hockey stadium in Lahore, Pakistan. Located inside the Nishtar Park Sports Complex, it is the largest terrace field hockey stadium in the world, having a capacity of 45,000 spectators.
